title: Milt Hinton, slap bass and Truck Parham
summary: Talk of slapping, Hinton's start on bass and Truck Parham.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, to go back to bass players, after you became established, did you teach other bass players, or other bass players, younger bass players come to you, like Truck or Milt Hinton, and want you to show them something?
Well, I don't know when Milt Hinton started on bass, because he started on the bass shortly after -- seemed like me, after I did. Might have been in the thirties.
See, because it was in the thirties when he left -- he went with Cab.
Right. Did you know Truck, Truck Parham?
Yeah. Well, you know, I met Truck. I can't remember exactly when I first met Truck.
Truck told me when he was a kid,
his family lived in Mecca Flats. And that he used to run beer for Freddie Keppard. Trumpet player.
